src/course/player.js.scope: Overview narration resolves to one track per chapter (overview-1..6); playback continues across chapters; the next lesson or chapter track is prefetched as a Blob after playback starts.

scripts/check-courses.cjs.scope: Narration check expects one track per lesson plus one per overview chapter, each covering its scenes in order.

README.md.scope: Documents 36 narration tracks, chapter split and background prefetch.

review_scope.feature: Split the 30-scene overview narration into six chapter tracks and prefetch the next track
review_scope.verification: Chapter cuts sit midway in the silence between chapters; all 36 track timelines matched the live player clauses; real-Chrome playback covered chapter start, prefetch of overview-2, seek inside chapter 1 and S04 to S05 rollover onto the prefetched track.
review_scope.not_verified: Human listening across chapter cut points; mobile Safari.
